verdict.rationale: Official pricing docs explicitly confirm a 7-day free trial with no credit card, followed by a free-forever Lite plan (10GB storage, free monthly compute) that supports real queries on real data, plus billing/usage dashboards to monitor costs. This directly matches the analyst story of evaluating without a credit card or sales call. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the free-tier signup flow (no community evidence corroborating ease of trial signup, only vendor docs).
